source.method: straight-line fit to the published characteristic curve over one log H window shared by all three channels, [-2.46, -0.56], on Kodak's printed lux-second axis, anchored at the printed EI 500 (the cine exposure index) through the ISO 5800 speed point (green and the slower of red and blue, each at minimum density plus 0.15), which sits +0.26 log H from where EI 500 (the cine exposure index) predicts, a shift of +0.26, which makes the window Kodak's [-2.2, -0.3]

name: Kodak Vision3 500T
note: Dye gammas are this stock's own, read off its maker's published characteristic curve. Nothing here is measured from a roll.
